none: PAS HESH-BDB175: Roman Coin: Radiate of Victorinus
contea di ritrovamento: Shropshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP C VICT]ORI[NVS P F AVG] ; R/ [SALVS AV]G

Copper alloy radiate probably of Victorinus (AD 269-271), reverse type Salus - possibly - holding sceptre and feeding snake rising from altar, SALVS AVG. Reece Period: 13. Obverse description: Bust of Victorinus, radiate, draped, right. Obverse inscription: [IMP C VICT]ORI[NVS P F AVG]. Reverse description: Salus - possibly - holding sceptre and feeding snake rising from altar,. Reverse inscription: [SALVS AV]G. Die axis measurement: 6 o'clock. Weight: 1.2g. Diameter: 18.1mm
